data.long_description:
Own a stunning high-floor residence in Golf Grand, Dubai Hills Estate, where breathtaking skyline views and iconic Burj Al Arab vistas create an exceptional living experience.

This brand-new 2-bedroom apartment spans 1,073 sq. ft. and offers bright, spacious interiors designed to maximize comfort and natural light. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame spectacular views, while the modern layout provides the perfect setting for both end-users and investors. Vacant and ready to move in, this home presents a rare opportunity to own a premium property in one of Dubai's most prestigious communities.

• 2 Bedrooms

• High Floor

• Brand New

Lifestyle Amenities:

Perfectly positioned in Dubai Hills Estate, residents enjoy effortless access to Dubai Hills Mall, Dubai Hills Golf Club, Dubai Hills Park, top schools, healthcare facilities, and major road networks.

Whether you're searching for your dream home or a high-performing investment, this apartment delivers the perfect combination of luxury, location, and unforgettable views.
